verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's MCP authentication docs list a named permission scope (`context:protected:read`), and probes confirm an OAuth-protected MCP endpoint and a device-code CLI login. Together these suggest scoped, per-agent authorization, but nothing shows a user deliberately issuing narrowly scoped credentials. missing for 10: documented user-facing issuance of scoped API keys or tokens for an agent, a full scope catalog and least-privilege selection at grant time, credential revocation or rotation, and hands-on corroboration that scopes restrict access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: A device-code login an agent can drive end to end up to the human approval step
